description: Search the Anime News Network encyclopedia for anime and manga by title. Returns one compact row per match: id, kind, type, name, precision and vintage. Use the id and kind with get_title to read the full entry. Matching is on substring, so a short query returns a lot: narrow the query rather than raising 'limit'. This searches titles only. It cannot find an entry from a plot detail, a character or a studio.

kind.description: Restrict results to one kind. The encyclopedia returns both by default.

query.description: Title or part of one, for example 'cowboy bebop'.

name: search_titles

id.description: Encyclopedia id. Pass this to get_title, together with 'kind'.

kind.description: Which get_title lookup this id belongs to.

precision.description: Disambiguator the site shows next to the name, such as 'TV 2'.

source_url.description: Encyclopedia page. Show this when citing the entry.

type.description: TV, movie, OAV, ONA, special, manga or novel.

vintage.description: Original release date or range, as published.

total_available.description: Rows this server could read, before 'limit' was applied. Higher than results.length means narrow the query.

title: Search the encyclopedia
